decisions.rationale: Local payload.db was missing the site_settings_same_as table added by 05-03's SiteSettings.address/sameAs fields, breaking `next build` prerender. Fixed by running a one-off script that imports payload.config and calls getPayload() under normal (non-production) NODE_ENV to trigger pushDevSchema against the on-disk payload.db, then reverted the payload.config.ts push:true experiment since it had no effect. The one-off script was deleted after use — not part of the repo.
